info.name: Materials Project Defect Tasks Materials Bonds API

params.name: material_ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of material_id values to query on

params.name: max_bond_length_max
params.description: Maximum value for the maximum bond length in the structure.

params.name: max_bond_length_min
params.description: Minimum value for the maximum bond length in the structure.

params.name: min_bond_length_max
params.description: Maximum value for the minimum bond length in the structure.

params.name: min_bond_length_min
params.description: Minimum value for the minimum bond length in the structure.

params.name: mean_bond_length_max
params.description: Maximum value for the mean bond length in the structure.

params.name: mean_bond_length_min
params.description: Minimum value for the mean bond length in the structure.

params.name: coordination_envs
params.description: Query by coordination environments in the material composition as a comma-separated list (e.g. 'Mo-S(6),S-Mo(3)')

params.name: coordination_envs_anonymous
params.description: Query by anonymous coordination environments in the material composition as a comma-separated list (e.g. 'A-B(6),A-B(3)')

params.name: _page
params.description: Page number to request (takes precedent over _limit and _skip).

params.name: _per_page
params.description: Number of entries to show per page (takes precedent over _limit and _skip). Limited to 1000.

params.name: _skip
params.description: Number of entries to skip in the search.

params.name: _limit
params.description: Max number of entries to return in a single query. Limited to 1000.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Fields to project from BondingDoc as a list of comma separated strings.                    Fields include: `builder_meta` `nsites` `elements` `nelements` `composition` `composition_reduced` `formula_pretty` `formula_anonymous` `chemsys` `volume` `density` `density_atomic` `symmetry` `material_id` `deprecated` `deprecation_reasons` `last_updated` `origins` `warnings` `structure` `property_name` `structure_graph` `method` `bond_types` `bond_length_stats` `coordination_envs` `coordination_envs_anonymous`
